title: AIDS control employees announce to intensify agitation over salary hike

ai.summary: Punjab AIDS Control Employees Welfare Association (PACEWA) announced intensified statewide agitation over unfulfilled promise of 20% salary hike, accusing state government of failing to honour commitment and bureaucratic delays.

facts.claim: Punjab AIDS Control Employees Welfare Association (PACEWA) has announced an intensification of its statewide agitation over the non-implementation of a promised 20 per cent salary hike
facts.quote: The Punjab AIDS Control Employees Welfare Association (PACEWA) has announced an intensification of its statewide agitation over the non-implementation of a promised 20 per cent salary hike

facts.claim: State president Jasmail Singh Deol and other members of the state committee said the government had promised before the Assembly elections to grant AIDS Control employees a 20 per cent salary increase on the Delhi pattern
facts.quote: State president Jasmail Singh Deol and other members of the state committee said the government had promised before the Assembly elections to grant AIDS Control employees a 20 per cent salary increase on the Delhi pattern

facts.claim: As part of the protest, employees from across Punjab held a massive demonstration at the department's head office in Chandigarh
facts.quote: As part of the protest, employees from across Punjab held a massive demonstration at the department's head office in Chandigarh

facts.claim: The association alleged that the department had been deliberately delaying the movement of files despite repeated assurances
facts.quote: The association alleged that the department had been deliberately delaying the movement of files despite repeated assurances

facts.claim: Deol said more than 85 meetings with government representatives and seven meetings of the Cabinet Sub-Committee had already been held to discuss the demand
facts.quote: Deol said more than 85 meetings with government representatives and seven meetings of the Cabinet Sub-Committee had already been held to discuss the demand

facts.claim: Although a consensus on implementing the hike is reached in every meeting, no official notification has been issued due to bureaucratic red tape
facts.quote: Although a consensus on implementing the hike is reached in every meeting, no official notification has been issued due to bureaucratic red tape

facts.claim: The Cabinet Sub-Committee meeting held on November 20 also remained inconclusive as the Principal Secretary had allegedly failed to forward the department's proposal to Finance Minister and Sub-Committee Chairman Harpal Singh Cheema
facts.quote: The Cabinet Sub-Committee meeting held on November 20 also remained inconclusive as the Principal Secretary had allegedly failed to forward the department's proposal to Finance Minister and Sub-Committee Chairman Harpal Singh Cheema

facts.claim: This was despite repeated directions from the Sub-Committee to implement the salary hike within 10 days
facts.quote: This was despite repeated directions from the Sub-Committee to implement the salary hike within 10 days

facts.claim: Association leaders said that, according to the department, the file had been sent to the Principal Secretary a month ago
facts.quote: Association leaders said that, according to the department, the file had been sent to the Principal Secretary a month ago

facts.claim: Before that, the then Project Director had forwarded the proposal to the department in March 2026
facts.quote: Before that, the then Project Director had forwarded the proposal to the department in March 2026

facts.claim: The state committee said employees had refrained from suspending work earlier, keeping public interest and patient care in mind
facts.quote: The state committee said employees had refrained from suspending work earlier, keeping public interest and patient care in mind

facts.claim: The association has warned that if the government fails to issue the official notification by December 1, the agitation will be intensified
facts.quote: The association has warned that if the government fails to issue the official notification by December 1, the agitation will be intensified

ai.background_note: Punjab AIDS Control Employees Welfare Association (PACEWA) is demanding a 20% salary hike for AIDS Control employees that the state government promised before Assembly elections but has not implemented.
